newsitem.title: USA: Johnson Controls says completes plastics sale.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Controls says completes plastics sale.

text.p: Johnson Controls Inc. said Tuesday it completed the $650 million sale of its Plastic Container Division to Schmalbach-Lubeca AG and expects to use the proceeds to reduce debt.
The division makes plastic beverage and food bottles in North America, Europe and South America.
Johnson Controls, which makes automotive systems and building controls, announced the sale to the German packaging company in February.
The price is subject to certain adjustments, it said.

Johnson Controls said it will use estimated after-tax proceeds of $475 million to $525 million to partially reduce debt incurred from its $1.35 billion acquisition of Prince, an automotive interiors supplier. The Prince deal was completed in October 1996.
Johnson Controls' stock fell 62.5 cents to $84.625 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
